No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you study Tughlaq capital-making, the Ashokan pillar and later beliefs.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Citadel entry
  • Mosque precinct
  • Ashokan pillar viewpoint
  • Remaining halls and walls

How the time is spent

  1. Citadel entry 25 min

    Locate Firozabad in Delhi city sequence.

    You: chronology card

  2. Mosque precinct 35 min

    Discuss mosque/citadel spatial functions.

    You: sketch plan

  3. Ashokan pillar viewpoint 35 min

    Explain relocation and epigraphic history.

    You: trace reuse

  4. Remaining halls and walls 25 min

    Discuss masonry and changing local traditions.

    You: evidence vs story

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Firoz Shah Kotla using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study Tughlaq capital-making, the Ashokan pillar and later beliefs.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Firoz Shah Kotla, Delhi

Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
